title: Loomground transport run
description: A conformance-vector run: activations, expected verdicts/master decisions, and the ordered verdict-labelled log trace.

repeat.description: determinism vectors only (conformance/README.md, Determinism vectors): the number of times a runner MUST evaluate `activations` against this vector's input.lg and check that every run's verdict/master/log result is identical.

permutations.description: determinism vectors only: paths, relative to the vector's directory, to one or more additional `.lg` files denoting the same policy with its declarations reordered (SYNTAX §3). A runner MUST evaluate `activations` against each and check the same verdict/master/log result as against input.lg.

token.description: optional: the declared token as presented, pinned per SPEC §7.4 where a vector tests that the record carries it alongside the host-observed facts.

observed.description: optional: the host-observed facts that produced this entry's effective kind/risk (SPEC §4, §7.4) — present only where a vector pins that the record carries both the declared token and the observation, not a reconciled value.
